correctness.rationale: The expected probability of a previously unseen species on the next draw is U_p(t)=sum_i p_i(1-p_i)^t. For fixed positive m-tuples, generalized real-power Descartes bounds zeros by coefficient sign changes, but full alternation of 2m terms is impossible because the sorted coordinates would strictly dominate in every position despite equal sum. Therefore at most 2m-2 real zeros; the forced zero at t=0 leaves at most 2m-3 for positive t. The rational rare-species construction a=b^2 adds two later sign changes at N≈1/b and a still later L, maintaining earlier strict signs; proof uses exponentially small original terms. Independently verified exact integer-power signs for three-species and four-species rational witnesses, including all five transitions for m=4.
